children.name: No one knows the unique demands of neurosurgery better than neurosurgeons. That’s why we’ve partnered with renowned leaders in the field to design and develop handcrafted, expertly engineered tools specially tailored to support control, efficiency, and workflow during your exacting procedures.  It all started in 1976 with Dr. Kenichiro Sugita That’s when this acclaimed neurosurgeon worked with Mizuho Corporation to develop the famous Sugita Clip for cerebral aneurysm.
